parameters.content:
## Failure Alerts

This workflow runs automatically whenever any claims workflow fails in production (it is set as the error workflow on all of them). It emails the admin the workflow name, failed node, error message, and a link to the execution. It does not need to be published — n8n invokes error workflows directly.
